python3 << 'EOF'
import re

# Data from the three years (10-year constant maturity nominal yields - monthly averages)
# 1993 from treasury_bulletin_1994_03_page_78.txt
data_1993 = {
    'Jan': 6.60, 'Feb': 6.26, 'Mar': 5.98, 'Apr': 5.97, 'May': 6.04, 'Jun': 5.96,
    'Jul': 5.81, 'Aug': 5.68, 'Sep': 5.36, 'Oct': 5.33, 'Nov': 5.72, 'Dec': 5.77
}

# 1998 from treasury_bulletin_1999_03_page_55.txt
data_1998 = {
    'Jan': 5.54, 'Feb': 5.57, 'Mar': 5.65, 'Apr': 5.64, 'May': 5.65, 'Jun': 5.50,
    'Jul': 5.46, 'Aug': 5.34, 'Sep': 4.81, 'Oct': 4.53, 'Nov': 4.83, 'Dec': 4.65
}

# 2003 from treasury_bulletin_2004_03_page_53.txt
data_2003 = {
    'Jan': 4.05, 'Feb': 3.90, 'Mar': 3.81, 'Apr': 3.96, 'May': 3.57, 'Jun': 3.33,
    'Jul': 3.98, 'Aug': 4.45, 'Sep': 4.27, 'Oct': 4.29, 'Nov': 4.30, 'Dec': 4.27
}

# Month order
months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

# Calculate 3-month moving averages for March through December
# March 3-month average = (Jan + Feb + Mar) / 3
# April 3-month average = (Feb + Mar + Apr) / 3
# etc.

def calc_moving_avg(data, target_month):
    idx = months.index(target_month)
    # Get the 3 months ending in target_month
    m1 = months[idx - 2]  # 2 months before
    m2 = months[idx - 1]  # 1 month before
    m3 = months[idx]      # target month
    avg = (data[m1] + data[m2] + data[m3]) / 3
    return avg, f"({m1}+{m2}+{m3})/3 = ({data[m1]}+{data[m2]}+{data[m3]})/3 = {avg:.4f}"

# Target months: March through December
target_months = ['Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

all_moving_avgs = []

print("="*60)
print("1993 3-Month Moving Averages (10-year constant maturity):")
print("="*60)
for tm in target_months:
    avg, detail = calc_moving_avg(data_1993, tm)
    print(f"{tm}: {detail}")
    all_moving_avgs.append(avg)

print("\n" + "="*60)
print("1998 3-Month Moving Averages (10-year constant maturity):")
print("="*60)
for tm in target_months:
    avg, detail = calc_moving_avg(data_1998, tm)
    print(f"{tm}: {detail}")
    all_moving_avgs.append(avg)

print("\n" + "="*60)
print("2003 3-Month Moving Averages (10-year constant maturity):")
